faqs.question: What should I do if my mark is missing?
faqs.answer: Search your unit, select your trainer and contact them first. If you are not directed to a contact, go to your Head of Department. You can also visit the Examinations office.

faqs.question: How do I know if my exam venue or time changes?
faqs.answer: Changes are sent to every student by email and posted on the Notice Board.

faqs.question: How do I apply for a retake?
faqs.answer: Download the Exam Retake Application form, fill it in and take it to the Examinations office. Ask the office for the retake fee.

faqs.question: How do I check my fee balance?
faqs.answer: Follow the online payment procedure to view your balance, or visit the Finance office.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if my payment fails?
faqs.answer: Contact the Finance Officer by email or visit the Finance office with your payment reference.

faqs.question: How do I recharge my mess card?
faqs.answer: Recharge your card at the Finance or mess counter, then check your balance and print a receipt there.

faqs.question: What if I lose my mess card?
faqs.answer: Report to Student Affairs. The administrator will deactivate the lost card and issue a replacement.

faqs.question: What if food is unavailable after I paid?
faqs.answer: Report to the mess supervisor to see when food will be available, or request a refund of your money through Student Affairs.

faqs.question: How do I join the institution?
faqs.answer: Visit the Registry/Admissions office for requirements and application guidance.

faqs.question: How do I book accommodation?
faqs.answer: Download the Accommodation Booking Form and submit it to Student Affairs.

faqs.question: How do I request ICT support?
faqs.answer: Use the ICT Support page or visit the ICT Helpdesk with the details of the problem.

faqs.question: Who do I send a complaint to?
faqs.answer: Send it to the department concerned. If you are unsure, send it to Student Affairs and it will be directed correctly.

guides.issue: Where and when do I sit my exam?
guides.steps:
Open Academics and check the Examination Timetable.
Note your unit, date, time and venue.
Arrive 30 minutes early with your student ID.
guides.note: If the venue or time changes, a notification is sent to every student by email.

guides.issue: How do I get my marks / results?
guides.steps:
Visit the Examinations department location below.
Normal exam results are issued immediately once released.
If a mark is missing, use the Missing Mark helper on this page.

guides.issue: How do I apply for a retake?
guides.steps:
Download the Exam Retake Application form.
Fill it in and attach your fee payment receipt.
Submit it to the Examinations office.
guides.cost: Confirm the current retake fee per unit with the Examinations office.

guides.issue: Who do I ask for other exam enquiries?
guides.steps: Visit the Examinations office or send an email.

guides.issue: How do I pay fees online?
guides.steps:
Go to the institution online payment page.
Enter the course and your student details.
Pay using the payment method shown.
Keep the confirmation message as proof of payment.

guides.issue: How do I check my fee balance?
guides.steps:
Use the online payment procedure to view your balance.
Or visit the Finance office with your student ID.

guides.issue: My payment failed. Who do I contact?
guides.steps:
Keep the payment reference or message.
Email or visit the Finance Officer with the reference.

guides.issue: I cannot pay in one go.
guides.steps:
Download the Fee Payment Plan Request form.
Submit it to the Finance office.

guides.issue: How do I recharge my mess card?
guides.steps:
Go to the mess or Finance counter.
Pay the amount you want to load.
Ask for a receipt and confirm the new balance.

guides.issue: How do I check my balance or print a receipt?
guides.steps:
Ask for a balance check at the mess counter.
Request a printed receipt at the same counter.

Report immediately to Student Affairs so the card is deactivated.
The administrator deactivates the old card.
Download the Lost Mess Card Replacement form and submit it.

guides.issue: Food is not available. What do I do?
guides.steps:
Ask the mess supervisor when the food will be available.
Check the Notice Board for updates.

guides.issue: Food was unavailable after I paid. How do I reclaim my money?
guides.steps:
Keep your receipt or card balance record.
Report to Student Affairs and request a refund.

guides.issue: How do I join the institution?
guides.steps:
Visit the Registry/Admissions office.
Get the entry requirements for your course.
Submit your application documents.

Download the Accommodation Booking Form.
Submit it to Student Affairs.

guides.issue: Where do I find my school or department?
guides.steps:
Software Development and ICT: Block B and ICT Block.
Examinations, Finance and Registry: Administration Block.
Student Affairs: Student Centre.

guides.issue: How do I request ICT support?
guides.steps:
Download and fill the ICT Support Request Form.
Submit it at the ICT Helpdesk or email it.

guides.issue: I cannot connect to the campus network.
guides.steps:
Confirm you are using the correct network name.
Restart your device and try again.
If it still fails, report to the ICT Helpdesk with your device and location.

guides.issue: A computer in the lab is faulty.
guides.steps:
Note the lab and the computer number.
Report it to the ICT Helpdesk.
